children: Oman’s Keryas Paper Industry, in partnership with Al Karama Hypermarket Group, Oman, will set up a $12 million, 20,000 metric tonnes per annum (MTPA) tissue manufacturing facility at Sohar Industrial City, Phase 7, Oman.
A Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to this effect has been signed at ProPaper 2026 in Dubai. The proposed facility is expected to commence commercial operations by the end of 2027.

The project is expected to be the first of its kind in this segment Oman and will be developed through a special-purpose joint venture company, Sohar Paper Products LLC, jointly owned by Keryas Paper Industry LLC, which operates a 150,000 MTPA kraft paper mill, and Al Karama Hypermarket Group, which operates 15 hypermarkets across Oman.

Abdul Nasser, Managing Director of Al Karama Group, said: “With our longstanding relationship with Keryas Group in Oman across the retail and packaging industries, we are confident of completing the project within the planned timeframe. This will be achieved despite the challenges currently facing industries across the GCC due to ongoing geopolitical tensions.”

Mohammed Omer Ali Al Hosni, CEO of Keryas Group, commented: “With our proven expertise in the paper manufacturing sector, this diversification represents an important step in expanding our product portfolio and customer base. It will strengthen our ability to offer comprehensive paper and packaging solutions to customers across the GCC market.”
The plant will be equipped with advanced tissue manufacturing machinery and technology from Taiwan, incorporating modern production capabilities to support efficient and high-quality manufacturing.
C2C Consultancy, India, will undertake the engineering and design activities for the project.—TradeArabia News Service

title: ZAWYA: Oman's Keryas, Al Karama plan $12mln manufacturing plant in Sohar
